column1: # Hungarian (hu) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    empty (WordCraft uses no contexts yet)
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Commands are nouns (Mentés, Másolás); second-person text uses the informal te form; labels
# capitalise only the first word, as Hungarian spelling does; product and format names stay as
# they are (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …). A noun after a number stays singular (3 oldal), so
# no plural forms are needed. Placeholders never take a case ending: the wording puts them after
# a colon or in parentheses instead.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
